name: What preparations should I make before a plumbing inspection?

mainEntity.name: What preparations should I make before a plumbing inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a plumbing inspection, it's helpful to ensure that areas around accessible plumbing, such as under sinks, around water heaters, and utility access panels, are clear of obstructions. Having a list of any plumbing concerns or observations you've made, such as dripping faucets or slow drains, can also guide the inspector. For example, if you've noticed a sudden drop in water pressure specifically in your master bathroom in Summerlin, mentioning this upfront can help the inspector focus their attention and diagnose potential issues more efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear access to plumbing areas and provide a list of any concerns you've noticed, such as a specific drop in water pressure in a particular area of your home.
